Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

#SevFinding
1HighOrbit/trackside cameras at lap frac 0 end inside the pit slab / main stand
10 of 72 frames (01,07,13,19,25,31,37,43,49,55) are a blank wall. Geometry: 402 m x 16 m x 12 m slab at 40 m gap (js/circuits/scenery/qatar.js:218-260) plus five 80 m stands at 15 m gap (:311-315) wrap the S/F. Fix: tool side (orbit step-round/--through) or pick frac 0.02 for goldens. Not a circuit defect.
2HighGreen verge / sand apron groundPatch tiles read as separate flat rectangles; dark floating boxes in wet, rain and dusk-rain
Verge patches every 14 m (:621-635), sand bays every 16 m (:643-660), 0.12-0.15 m thick, samples:2. Visible seams and steps on slopes (frames 02,03,09,15,16,18,33,57,60). In wet weather the sand patches lose their warm colour and read as dark slabs. Mechanism: per-tile flat boxes vs continuous terrain. Fix: shorter/overlapping drape with samples>2, or make the apron a terrain-colour zone; confirm wet albedo of groundPatch.
3MediumBrief says continuous green->sand sandwich; built verge is discrete patches and sand bays cover only ~50% of the lap
Eight bay windows [0.10-0.22, 0.26-0.38, 0.52-0.66, 0.78-0.90] x 2 sides (:643-653). Frame trap: these fractions are in the AUTHORED frame; with _sceneryShift 0.6953 (measured) authored 0.10 = racing 0.795, so 'T2/T3 outer' (comment :645) actually lies on the T14-T16 approach and authored 0.78-0.90 = racing 0.475-0.595. docs/tracks/qatar.md concedes the mid-lap tables are not at their section fractions. Fix: re-key through sl() or fix comments.
4MediumDay weather presets are flat; fog barely affects the sky/horizon
Day-fog (43-48) shows a clear saturated blue sky with ground haze only; day-dry has a uniform orange ground and unlit black pit-slab face. pal.fogDensity 0.0015 (js/circuits/qatar.js:41). Night-event circuit so day is secondary; fog/sky tuning belongs to lighting-tuner. Not caused by scenery code.
5MediumKatara Towers read as a dark leaning A-frame; comment says 16 km / 8.5 km but props sit at 740 / 720 m
js/circuits/scenery/qatar.js:497-498 (stale comment) vs :517,:533. Pair of 110 m frusta with opposing lean 0.14 (:522-526) looks like a pylon top right in frames 06,12,18,24 etc. Brief itself says 229/152 m beyond nearest road and offers the Fuji approach (3-5 km). Fix: move out + scale, fix comment.
6LowBanking declared but not built
bankZones lists 7 zones (js/circuits/qatar.js:46-54) but def.banked=false and the built centreline bank is 0 everywhere (measured). Only the kerb strips consume the fracs (scenery :184-194). Uncertain whether banked:false is deliberate for a near-flat track.
7LowNight near-field sand overexposed; mast poles dark with small heads
Frames 07-12: foreground sand is blown out and blobby-textured; most mast shafts are dark grey. 46-50 m masts at 34 m (:155-157), pool:false so ground washes are engine light only. Needs a GPU check; software render may exaggerate.
8LowMain-stand 'continuous' stand has 28 m gaps
five 80 m stands at 0.02 spacing = 108 m pitch (:311-315). Brief says one long covered stand.
